findings: SFTP adapter lists remote directory entries, skips dot/dotdot, marks d as folder and all other types including symlinks as files. Original post-connect method control confirms behavior; no content hashes/deduplication.

Connection awaits outside list/stat/exists catch. Connect failure propagates, while post-connect list failure logs and returns accumulated empty/partial arrays, stat null and exists false. Two isolated list controls confirm distinction. No completeness flag added by VirtualAdapter.
Original binary read slices byteOffset/byteLength correctly on Buffer subview, unlike S3 fast path. Text read decodesUTF8. Real protocol/chunking/fullfile integration untested.

Append uses client exists and then read/write; client existence/read failures propagate instead of silently replacing file. Still read-modify-write, no concurrent version/atomic append guarantee. copy buffers whole file. No mutation methods invoked.

Connection lifecycle shares inflight connect promise, checks channel readiness, uses revision/abort around reconnect and closes clients on failure. Upstream tests mock protocol callbacks and authentication; reviewed only, not live connection qualification.

Adapter stat maps atime toctime and mtime tomtime, ignores modifyTime interface field; creation time is not established by access time. Directory detection with bit040000 rather than full mode type mask may misclassify special modes; provider values unverified.
remove falls back to recursive rmdir on any delete error, not just directory classification. Static only; no removal execution or reproduction. Main UI choices remain separately unqualified.

Full upstream SFTPAdapter tests read: fingerprint formatting, approval before authentication, cancellation, channel loss and shared concurrent connection under synthetic client. No real SSH/SFTP server, key file or credentials accessed.

executed_controls.method: Original SFTP adapter I/O methods after Node type stripping and original normalizePath mock. Prototype fake client and overridden no-op/failing connect isolate post-connect semantics; lifecycle/authentication not executed.

limits: No network/server/credentials/private key access, no full upstream suite or production changes.
